amendment_of.quoted_rule: Use training seed 17 per cell; do not automatically add independent seeds ... Any extra seeds require a prospective allocation and complete accounting.
amendment_of.lineage: Partial honouring of the historical proposal's statistical protocol (docs/research_proposal.md section 6.4 'at least five training seeds'; spec issue #38 'Headline cells use five seeds'). This protocol is the prospective amendment required by plan.md:67-69; it lets the headline contrasts report seed robustness instead of claiming no training-seed variance (synthesis-v1/README.md claim boundary).

training_seeds.selection_rule: Arbitrary primes disjoint from every seed used by the expanded-nine-day-v1 program (17 training/evaluation, 64 curriculum shuffled ordering, 1729 analysis bootstrap, 90717 modality-stress bootstrap, 42613 corruption master, 1013/2027/3041/4001 random-valid rollout seeds). Seeds 29 and 71 appear in the deprecated CGAS-era issue54 bfs_phase outputs (different corpus, trainer and cells, predating this program); that unrelated historical usage shares no data or cell with this amendment and cannot taint the selection. Frozen before launch: no seed-29 or seed-71 artifact exists for either selected cell family (every expanded-program cell was trained with seed 17 only), so no outcome was observed for either seed on the selected cells.

seed_effects.baseline_process_sft_fresh_adapter: The new seed drives the fresh LoRA A/B initialization (set_seed(training_seed) immediately before get_peft_model in load_training_model) and the lora_dropout 0.05 RNG. Data order is seed-independent: SequentialSampler over the frozen membership.json record order. Everything else (512 records, one epoch, 16 updates, all hyperparameters) is identical to the original v5 cell.
seed_effects.dagger_iteration_1_continuation: The new seed drives only the lora_dropout 0.05 RNG: starting adapter weights are loaded from the verified seed-17 checkpoints (never re-initialized), the sampler is SequentialSampler over the verified seed-17 memberships, and each cell starts a new optimizer and scheduler. 512 records, one epoch, 16 updates, all hyperparameters identical to the original cells.
seed_effects.evaluation: Evaluation seed 17 with greedy decoding (do_sample false) in every arm and seed, identical to the original frozen evaluation contracts; the evaluation seed is inert under greedy decoding and is kept for contract identity.

baseline_process_sft.selection: best_first_add_greedy x multimodal-state: the headline algorithm family of the expanded matched baseline's primary positive contrast (process_sft - pretrained_base = +0.903 pooled, synthesis-v1 section 2) in the program's titular modality. Selected by decision relevance, not by outcome.

evaluation.call_limit: 2x matching exact-reference decisions per episode, independent of expansions
evaluation.seed17_evidence: docs/experiments/expanded-study/baseline-evaluation.json (process_sft best_first_add_greedy multimodal-state 21/24, already replay-verified; no re-run)
evaluation.comparators: pretrained_base, random_valid, exact_reference reused from the replay-verified baseline episodes at zero new GPU cost

dagger_iteration_1.selection: The DAgger iteration-1 vs exposure-matched continued-SFT comparison (ticket #127 candidate b). The estimand is defined within each modality across both arms from the same starting adapter, so all six cells (3 modalities x 2 arms) are required; dropping any arm or modality would break the frozen estimand.

training.membership_integrity: Every replicated cell consumes exactly the 512 record IDs in exactly the order recorded under training_record_ids of the matching verified seed-17 cell report (outputs/expanded-study/v1/dagger/training/{modality}/{arm}/iteration-1/report.json); the runner hard-fails on any difference. Verified memberships are read, never rewritten or re-stamped.
training.optimizer_state: new optimizer and scheduler per cell; load adapter weights only

evaluation.seed17_note: The original program evaluated only iteration-two final checkpoints (goal6-completion-audit.json fixed_evaluation); the verified seed-17 iteration-1 checkpoints were never panel-evaluated. They are evaluated here inference-only under the same frozen contract so the comparison's seed-17 point exists; no seed-17 artifact is retrained or modified.
evaluation.comparators: original_process_sft, random_valid, exact_reference reused from the replay-verified original DAgger evaluation episodes at zero new GPU cost

independent_replay.machinery: replay_visual_episode over read-only persisted views (examples/planning_benchmark_slice/visual_episode.py), via independently_replay (baseline cell) and verify_episode (DAgger cells); CPU-only, no model calls

analysis.per_seed: Every seed reported individually: per-cell successes, invalid operations, decisions, expansions; per-seed paired whole-problem contrasts (baseline cell: process_sft - pretrained_base over 24 tasks; DAgger: dagger_iteration_1 - continued_sft_iteration_1 per modality and pooled over the 72 unseen + 9 development rows).
analysis.aggregated: Mean and min-max range across the three seeds for every reported rate and contrast; cross-seed aggregation is descriptive only (n = 3 seeds).
analysis.bootstrap: Paired whole-problem bootstrap per seed, 10,000 resamples, 95% percentile intervals, seed 1729 (the program convention).
analysis.tiny_subgroup_rule: Cells and strata below 8 paired units are descriptive-only.
analysis.publication: docs/experiments/expanded-study/synthesis-v1/seed-variance-addendum.md + seed-variance.json (+ CSV); synthesis-v1/README.md and every closed-ticket verdict remain byte-untouched (the synthesis regeneration anchors pin the pre-#126 ledger); this addendum appends seed-variance evidence only.

budget.transfer: None: both branch remainders exceed the frozen estimates with wide margin; the ticket's 6-15 GPU-h envelope holds; total program cap 336 GPU-h unchanged.
budget.cutoff: The scheduler admits a GPU job only if now + max_seconds precedes the 2026-09-21T11:55:19Z program cutoff. The ticket's not-bound-by-the-cutoff clause is a VALID_STOP safety valve, not a schedule amendment (identical reading to #126): if the frozen scope cannot launch inside the admissible window, the ticket declares VALID_STOP without partial-outcome harvesting.

execution.scheduler: scripts/run_expanded_study.py launch against the shared production ledger outputs/expanded-study/v1/budget.json; one model worker per GPU; MASTER_PORT from the frozen pool 18800-18805; per-stage CPU completion audit hooks; a CPU chain job advances stages exactly once and never relaunches a completed attempt
execution.per_seed_output_roots: outputs/expanded-study/v1/seed-replication/{baseline,dagger}/seed-{17,29,71} so no replicated artifact ever collides with or overwrites an original artifact
declared_code_changes: examples/planning_benchmark_slice/visual_model.py train_visual: TrainingArguments seed/data_seed and the report seed field read config['training_seed'] instead of the hardcoded 17 (byte-identical behavior for every seed-17 study config; no historical artifact is re-run or altered)

examples/planning_benchmark_slice/expanded_dagger_evaluation.py run_cell: the frozen arm gate reads protocol['evaluation'].get('new_arms', ARMS) instead of the module constant alone (the original dagger protocol declares new_arms equal to ARMS, so its behavior is unchanged)
new scripts/run_expanded_seed_replication.py + job configs configs/experiments/expanded-study/seed-replication-*-job.json + chain driver; no frozen gate of the original protocols is loosened

execution_rules.design_gate: GPU launches require explicit user authorization after this frozen amendment is presented; CPU preparation (validate stages, the 18093 backend service) is not a GPU launch.
